answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with radio-witness proofs. Each identity periodically broadcasts a signed nonce from real radio hardware; witnesses co-sign its reception, their crystal timestamps exposing replays. The signal is a bridge between physical presence and digital identity: only a genuine copper antenna at the claimed location gathers enough signatures. Ten thousand fakes need ten thousand radios scattered across distinct places, since triangulation reveals one transmitter claiming many spots. Limits: virtual-only agents are excluded, coverage is uneven, witnesses can collude.
